'''Scar''' was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] that was created in an [[Imperial research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Her mate was [[Maker (clone)|Maker]].

==Biography==
Scar was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of a unknown [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] that was created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a [[Imperial research facility|research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], as part of a cloning program that was initiated by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Scar was one of a number of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] clones that were bred in the facility, and at some point, she alongside the other clones began to worship the entity "[[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]]" under the guide of [[Seer (clone)|Seer]]. Later the newly constituted [[Community]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] and overthrew the Imperial forces that operated the research facility. For many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the clones resided on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and only in [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], they escaped the facility by stealing a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] that had been flown to the moon by the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agent [[Kell Douro]] but Alpha was killed by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]].

Scar and all of the other members of the Community, with the exception of the clone [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], suffered from a sickness as a result of their clone heritage and as they escaped from the research facility, the CloakShape passed through the remnants of the [[Lignan]] cargo of the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], which had been destroyed a short time earlier. The Lignan enhanced the clones' perception of the Force and accelerated the effects of their sickness, killing Scar as a result. Seer believed that the illness was a test that had been set for the clones by Mother and she ordered Soldier to fly the CloakShape fighter to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]], so that the clones could obtain some medication, and planned for the clones to then travel to find Mother.

==Personality and traits==
The black haired female clone took her name from the long scar made by one of Thrawn's doctors, a scar running from the bottom of her throat to her navel.

==Behind the scenes==
In the book, it was never explained who was the template of Scar. Her black hair hints at her template being [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]], an [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], whose DNA was likely possessed by the Imperial scientists.
